0x0007A6.en: 「As I am now...@ this is as far as I go...!」

0x00089F.en: 「Damn it!@　You won't get me next time!」

0x0009C8.en: 「So this is as far as I go...!?」

0x000B58.en: 「Blew it...!@　Nothing to do but bail...」

0x000CA9.en: 「This is it... The rest is on you.」

0x000D55.en: 「No good, I've taken too much damage... Retreating!」

0x000DA2.en: 「Well, that's a loss. The rest is yours.」

0x000DE0.en: 「Eek! I shall leave the rest to you!」

0x000E27.en: 「The Granzon... shot down, of all things...」

0x000ED2.en: 「Ugh... To think I'd be the falling star... Ejecting!」

0x000FCA.en: 「Well now, dang if they didn't get me good!」

0x00107B.en: 「Ugh! All hands, abandon ship at once!!」

0x0010C2.en: 「Sorry, I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x0010F7.en: 「Damn it! Is this the limit of my power...!」

0x0011B4.en: 「Ugh... You're as good as they say.」

0x0011E3.en: 「To fall here... how green I still am...!」

0x001231.en: 「No good, I can't hold on! I'm pulling back!」

0x0012EC.en: 「Sorry, the rest is up to you!」

0x00131B.en: 「N-no good! This is as far as I go!!」

0x001359.en: 「Well, well. So this is my limit.」

0x001388.en: 「I can't manage any more. I'll take my leave.」

0x001579.en: 「I am retreating...@　Ngh...! I couldn't pull it off...」

0x001777.en: 「This is as far as I go!!」

0x0017A6.en: 「So I still have much to learn...!」

0x0018FB.en: 「...A dangerous sign.@　Those humans have gained new power, and their@　synchronization with Glacies and Ventos grows stronger.」

0x0019AD.en: 「Yes, and it seems to be tearing them apart.@　Can they be repaired?」

0x001A15.en: 「I have taken measures, but to no good effect.」

0x001A4C.en: 「Then perhaps it is nearly time to cut them loose, khehehe.」

0x001A89.en: 「...As I thought, unless that human and the system are destroyed,@　the problem will not be solved.」

0x001B01.en: 「You said there was something you wished to confirm. Is that acceptable?」

0x001B4D.en: 「My judgment accounts for that.@　If that human brings ill effects upon Ventos,@　the quality of our sustenance may suffer.」

0x001BE9.en: 「Then it would be safest to remove her from her current role.@　We can offer up sustenance even without her.」

0x001C87.en: 「But that would delay the awakening of the King of Ruin.」

0x001CCA.en: 「Either way, Ventos as she is now changes nothing.@　Better to give her a different role.」

0x001D51.en: 「To serve as the energy source@　for the Officinas I am now building.」

0x001DB9.en: 「That will raise the operation rate@　and let us multiply the legions of ruin faster.@　In short, we offset the drop in quality with quantity.」

0x001E5E.en: 「True, we urgently need more Officinas.@ Until now the King of Ruin's power let us transmute@ this land's matter into legions, but...」

0x001F30.en: 「The more sources the better.@　We can efficiently sow fear and despair@　among the humans of every land.」

0x001FE5.en: 「But if we use Ventos...@　there is a strong chance those humans will learn of her@　existence through the system and come.」

0x00208D.en: 「Khehehe, that too is exactly as I intend.@　When they do, not only Ventos but Glacies as well@　shall prove useful, khehehehe.」

0x00214B.en: 「Laki... you and I, along with Ventos,@　are to go to Contagio's Officinas.」

0x0021C8.en: 「Even broken as I am,@　there is still a role left to give me...」

0x00221E.en: （If I go outside,@　I might run into Joshua Radcliff...）

0x00227D.en: 「What is it, Laki? Why do you make that face?」

0x0022D0.en: （...It's wrong, this is wrong.@　Laki's disturbance is wrong. It can't be.）

0x002338.en: （Among all of the Melior Esse, only we two@　were born at the same moment. We should have been the same...）

0x0023BB.en: （I know it's because of that human@　and the system, but...）

0x0024AF.en: 「Lieutenant Hugo made it back safe and sound...@　so it's part welcome-back, part get-well celebration.」

0x002526.en: 「We thought we'd whip up some simple dishes ourselves.」

0x002582.en: 「We've cleared it with Major Kai too.@　What do you think...?」

0x0025D8.en: （...A brutal battle is waiting ahead of us, but@　that's all the more reason to build up our spirits...）

0x00265B.en: 「Thanks for being so considerate.@　I'll bring Hugo along and join you.」

0x0026CC.en: 「All right, to celebrate Lieutenant Hugo Medio's@　miraculous return... cheers!」

0x002775.en: 「Now then, Lieutenant Hugo!@　A few words from you, please!」

0x0027CE.en: （Th-this has turned into such a big deal...）

0x00286D.en: 「E-everyone... you've gone to such trouble@　and worry on my account. The situation still@　allows no room for ease, but from here on...」

0x002983.en: 「No kidding. You sound like Major Kai.」

0x0029BA.en: 「Then what... you want me to just say 'I'm home'?」

0x0029F7.en: 「That'd have been just fine, wouldn't it?」

0x002A28.en: 「What's that supposed to mean?@　It's not like you're back at your own house.」

0x002A78.en: （Home... huh.@　Even so, having a place to come back to@　is something to be grateful for...）

0x002AF6.en: （That's right... even with a body like this, I still have...）

0x002B70.en: 「...Hugo, I know you're in no mood@　to make merry, but...@　think of it as a change of pace, all right?」

0x002C1F.en: 「Um, can I start eating already, yo?」

0x002CA6.en: 「Yes, I pried all sorts of things about@　Japanese cooking out of my big brother...@　I hope it suits your tastes.」

0x002D30.en: 「My posting is Shimoda in Japan, so lately@ I'm a washoku fan. I'll gladly have some.」

0x002D9B.en: 「Nikujaga, saikyo-grilled Spanish mackerel,@　and spinach ohitashi. A Japanese person's dream.」

0x002E4A.en: 「Yeah, this taste... it's really good, Presia.@　Skilled enough to open your own place.」

0x002EBE.en: 「Thank you so much.@　This ship had more ingredients on hand than I expected...」

0x002F29.en: 「That's thanks to Ratsel.@　The man has an extraordinary obsession with food.」

0x002F8E.en: 「Someone like him might even bring back@　ingredients all the way from La Gias.」

0x002FED.en: 「By the way, where's Touma? I don't see him...」

0x00305B.en: 「Is that so? He's really dedicated, that guy.」

0x003098.en: 「But that's not the whole of it.@　Axel wouldn't allow him to join this gathering.@　Said it'd be a waste of time.」

0x00313D.en: 「He looks after people better than you'd expect, that man...」

0x0031B1.en: 「Lim and the others helped me make rice balls too.@ Please, have some if you like.」

0x00321C.en: 「Then I'll take Ryoto and Ing's share too.」

0x0032BF.en: 「Munch, munch... salmon inside, huh? Tastes like Mom's.」

0x0033BA.en: 「I-I made that one... was it no good?」

0x0033FD.en: 「Putting strawberry jam in a rice ball@　is hardly standard...」

0x0034A2.en: 「Ohh... I'm sorry...@　I thought it might help with fatigue...」

0x003501.en: 「Oh, I wouldn't have minded even more jam.」

0x003573.en: 「You too, huh? A hopeless sweet tooth?@　Just like Tytti.」

0x0035CF.en: 「Sweet things... I like them. Quite a lot.」

0x00362F.en: 「Then maybe you and Ibis would hit it off.」

0x003666.en: 「...Lord Raidy, allow me to serve you a portion.」

0x0036D7.en: 「Please, don't hold back.@ Do eat as much as you'd like.」

0x003730.en: 「That's right. A man's got to eat hearty.」

0x003776.en: 「I-I'm a big eater too, actually, Lune.」

0x0037C2.en: 「Oh, really? Then I'll dish you up.@　This and this, that and that too... there!」

0x00383C.en: （Th-th-this much...!@　But I'll finish every bite!）

0x00388F.en: （Uh-oh...@　Hope Zash doesn't overeat and wreck his stomach.）

0x003950.en: 「Ah, no... I just thought Kusuha might@　bring out that certain thing...」

0x0039DA.en: 「...Bullet, I leave the forward to you.」

0x003A61.en: 「You're new, so you wouldn't know, but@　it's the Steel Dragon Squadron's baptism... a rite of passage, of sorts.」

0x003AE8.en: 「Its name: the dreaded Kusuha Juice...@　It's a nutrient drink, and one sip of it@　once laid Lamia out cold.」

0x003B84.en: 「Yeah, foul beyond words, that stuff...@　Like Yang Long's lectures, it's something I never@　want to experience twice.」

0x003C17.en: 「How rude.@　And just how potent is this beverage's effect?」

0x003C5E.en: 「Well, the aftereffects sure do kick in something fierce, though.」

0x003C9B.en: （If it's that effective, I probably ought to drink some too, for the sake of@　the operations ahead......）

0x003D21.en: 「That look on your face... don't tell me you're gonna try it?」

0x003DA8.en: 「U-um... I've got@　juice, tea, and coffee...」

0x003E26.en: 「If you mean my nutrient drink,@　I've been making all sorts of improvements to it lately...」

0x003EC8.en: 「...Now that I know it's safe, I'll take that coffee.」

0x003F14.en: 「Oh, that one's... the cup Irui made@　for Major Sanger.」

0x003FB1.en: 「A child needn't use such a stiff form of address.@　Sanger will do.」

0x004059.en: 「Irui wanted the Major to have it,@　so she brewed it all by herself.」

0x0041E4.en: 「Old man Sanger drank Irui's coffee@　and just keeled over...」

0x004249.en: 「Ah... I see.@　Irui, did you put brandy or something in the coffee?」

0x0042B4.en: 「Y-yes... I read it in a book...@　it said adding some to tea makes it delicious...@　so I thought I'd try it with coffee too...」

0x004359.en: 「But brandy...@　could that be the stuff Ruslan brought aboard?」

0x0043CA.en: 「I dunno much, but putting booze in@　can't be a good idea, can it?」

0x00449A.en: 「Aye. Sanger can't hold his liquor,@　but he sobers up quick enough.」

0x00450F.en: 「Means a body that can't drink.@　Sanger's an extreme case, mind you, even a drop of alcohol@　does this to him.」

0x0045AB.en: 「Whaaat!?@　I-I'm sorry, I'm so sorry, Sanger!」

0x004604.en: 「That man, a lightweight like that...@　guess you can't judge a book by its cover, huh.」

0x0046CB.en: 「That's right, it's not like you meant any harm.」

0x004714.en: 「Yeah... the fault's mine, for not warning@　Irui about it beforehand...」

0x00479E.en: 「Major Sanger isn't a man who gets angry over little things.@　It's all right, Irui.」

0x004960.en: 「...Brooklyn, I want to work up a sweat.@　Spar with me.」

0x004A5D.en: 「Then we'll run the Sympathia's cut-off test.@ We're in the hangar, so there's no crash risk, but...@ report anything unusual right away.」

0x004B7D.en: 「A voice... I can hear a voice...!!」

0x004BFE.en: 「Y-yes... through the Sympathia...@　he was calling to me...」

0x004CEA.en: 「No... I think it's far away...@　I don't know the exact place, but... the direction...」

0x004DB4.en: 「Hmm... isn't this different from the@　pattern we've seen so far?」

0x004E10.en: 「Yeah... unless they were fairly close,@　the synchronization phenomenon never occurred.」

0x004E7B.en: 「Either Ventos's thoughts have grown stronger,@ strong enough to reach Lim...@ or they're being relayed somehow...」

0x004F17.en: 「Or the sensitivity of Lim or the Sympathia@ may have increased...」

0x004FCB.en: 「Either way, it's a remarkably obvious trap.」

0x004FFF.en: 「Right... there's almost no chance@　Ventos is the only one there.」

0x005064.en: 「Major Kai, shouldn't we report this@　to Colonel Lefina?」

0x0050C7.en: 「...There's the matter of Pillbox 8 as well.@　That story of hers is troubling.」

0x005129.en: 「I'd say there's a strong chance it's a Ruina trap.」

0x00517C.en: 「Well, they are drawing us out to them.」

0x0051C2.en: 「...Then let's take the bait on purpose,@ to gather intelligence on the Ruina.@ Major Kai, which direction did Lim mean?」

0x00528D.en: 「Contact on radar!@ Ruina unit approaching, closing straight in from one o'clock!」

0x0052EC.en: 「Colonel, the direction the enemy came from matches Lim's account.」

0x005348.en: 「There may be something connected to the Ruina@　out beyond that.」

0x0053B3.en: 「Then find every city, military facility,@ and factory lying along the straight line@ Lim pointed to. Width, one hundred kilometers.」

0x005480.en: 「Major Kai and the others, sortie at once.」

0x0054C5.en: 「Target group Alpha through Hotel, closing on our ship!」

0x005505.en: 「All guns, upper VLSM, ready to fire!」

0x005570.en: 「Just like Dr. Wong said, it's steadier than the old one.@　It handles some of the DFC automatically too.」

0x0055EA.en: 「Good... for now, we stay like this, in Form G.」

0x00562D.en: 「Once it turns into a gunfight, leave it to me, all right?@　I built up plenty of experience while you were gone.」

0x005704.en: 「Nothing, just... a tandem seat really ought to@　have two people in it. For all my griping,@　I guess flying solo was lonely.」

0x0057B2.en: 「Aren't you being sweet all of a sudden.」

0x0057E6.en: 「Well, I couldn't exactly seat a capybara here.」

0x00582C.en: 「Never mind, forget I said it.@　Let's finish the shakedown with this operation.」

0x005925.en: 「It's because System LIOH capped the battle style it set,@ factoring in DML feedback to narrow@ each joint's range of motion.」
